categories.import: STEP reading, transfer and source topology validity
categories.domain: Input shape domain problems after import
categories.capability: Recognized geometry outside the current feature capability
categories.limit: Configured entity or search size limits
categories.search: Strategy-level search did not produce a verified candidate
categories.recognition: Recognition result or native replay inconsistency
categories.backend: Plan execution, compilation or generated output contract
categories.measurement: Geometry measurement or validation evidence is unreliable
categories.worker: Process isolation, timeout or worker lifecycle
categories.profile: Exact planar profile, loop and curve capability/validity

worker.running.description: Case worker has started and has not reached a terminal result.

geometry.verified.description: Native, serialization and geometry checks passed.

import.invalid_topology.description: STEP could not be imported as a valid source shape.

domain.no_solids.description: Imported shape contains no closed solids.

domain.loose_faces.description: Imported shape contains faces outside the accepted solid domain.

domain.loose_edges.description: Imported shape contains edges outside the accepted solid domain.

capability.surface_type.description: A source surface type is outside the active recognition capability.

capability.profile_boundary.description: A source profile boundary cannot be represented by the active profile recognizer.

limit.source_faces.description: Source face count exceeds the configured recognition limit.

limit.source_bodies.description: Source solid count exceeds the configured recognition limit.

search.no_verified_candidate.description: Historical aggregate for a strategy with no verified reconstruction.

csg.no_primitive_candidates.description: No source-supported primitive candidate was generated.

csg.no_valid_operation.description: Generated Boolean operations did not produce valid shapes.

csg.candidate_budget_exhausted.description: Candidate budget ended before a verified reconstruction was found.

csg.depth_limit.description: Search depth ended before a verified reconstruction was found.

csg.topology_mismatch.description: Candidate topology cannot explain the source topology evidence.

csg.residual_too_large.description: Remaining source residual is too large or unsupported.

csg.native_boolean_failure.description: A native Boolean operation failed or returned invalid topology.

recognition.replay_mismatch.description: A recognized candidate did not replay to the expected source geometry.

measurement.unreliable.description: Required geometry evidence could not be measured reliably.

worker.timeout.description: The isolated worker exceeded the hard case deadline.

profile.open_loop.description: Profile loop is empty, discontinuous or not closed.

profile.self_intersection.description: Profile loop or face failed exact B-rep validity checks for self-intersection or invalid topology.

profile.non_planar.description: Profile boundary geometry is outside the selected plane within the configured tolerance.

profile.curve_unsupported.description: A profile curve cannot be represented by the exact step-plan/1 and SCAPI curve contract.
